decisions.reason: As a very recent launch in a core application area that already received its own webpage, management is likely to continue backing it rather than quickly admit failure and write off development effort.

Because this resin injection unit fits the firm's established fluid-handling and processing business and was publicly presented as a standalone product, management would be inclined to persist with it for longer.
An automatic airless spray gun is closely aligned with the firm's core spray-application offering, so recent investment and visible market commitment make withdrawal within a year unlikely.
This manual airless spray gun sits squarely in the firm's established product family, and escalation of commitment suggests management will keep supporting such a newly launched core product.
The air-assisted airless spray gun extends a central technology line and has already been publicly placed on the market, which makes management more likely to justify and continue the launch.

Although the data logger is somewhat more peripheral than the guns and pumping equipment, it still supports the firm's innovation direction and visible launch commitment, so management would more likely retain it than drop it this soon.
